answer: PoA identity verification uses a Wesolowski VDF: a fixed chain of modular squarings is sequential, since each square depends on the preceding result. Simulating many identities cannot split one chain across GPUs or shorten its physical delay; every clone must incur the same elapsed computation before its proof is accepted. This time bottleneck makes copied dune, yarrow, and atlas identities economically ineffective for Sybil attacks.
